import { handle } from '@jigging/flow'
import { mkdir, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { join } from 'node:path'

await handle(async run => {
  const { mode } = run.input as { mode: string }
  if (mode !== 'generation' && mode !== 'test') throw Error('Unsupported deadline control')
  const root = run.attachments.candidate!.path
  for (const name of ['src', 'tools', 'test']) await mkdir(join(root, name))
  await writeFile(join(root, 'src/answer.ts'), 'export const answer: number = 42\n')
  await writeFile(join(root, 'tools/generate.js'), `
console.log('deadline-generation-start')
console.error('cwd:' + process.cwd())
console.error('module:' + import.meta.path)
${mode === 'generation' ? "console.log('g'.repeat(80 * 1024)); for (;;) {}" : "await Bun.write('generated/answer.json', JSON.stringify({answer:42})); console.log('generate-complete')"}
`)
  await writeFile(join(root, 'test/answer.test.js'), `
import { test } from 'bun:test'
test('intentional native test deadline', () => {
  console.log('deadline-test-start')
  console.error('cwd:' + process.cwd())
  console.error('module:' + import.meta.path)
  console.log('t'.repeat(80 * 1024))
  for (;;) {}
})
`)
  return { outcome: 'done', output: { mode } }
})
